gaps.what: The 1853 doubling of Cliopatria's shape (about +495,000 km2 after removing the Gulf coast, Qatar, Oman, Kuwait and Ha'il) is not dated or described by any page; the 1866, 1873, 1885 and 1890 contractions are bridges at confidence 1
Infobox (area, capital names, predecessor fields) lost in the extractor; no area comparison; no ruler strip because the pages give only part of the reigns
When al-Jawf, Tayma and Khaybar became Rashidi, when the Qassim passed to the Rashidis (1877 is Cliopatria's), and who held al-Jawf 1906-1916
Division of the Buraimi oasis (Buraimi and Hamasa to Oman, Al Ain to Abu Dhabi) is undated; no borders of the individual sheikhdoms

How far Ibn Saud's land reached in 1902-1905 (only Riyadh on the pages), the Najd between Riyadh and Qassim in 1905 (Battle of Rawdat Muhanna page silent on Sudair, Kharj, Aflaj), the northern frontier lands Cliopatria adds in 1922 (Ikhwan raids on Transjordan page silent; its infobox says Transjordan later 'retrieves Al-Jawf, Wadi Sirhan and Kaf'), and the month of the 1920 Abha capture

Date of Bahr el Ghazal and the Upper Nile under Egypt (1877 is Cliopatria's); who took Zeila and Berbera in April 1884; the Mahdist surrender dates of Al Ubayyid (1882) and Darfur (1883); the extent of Equatoria in 1870; about 200 cells of Cliopatria's 1877-1884 shape (Ogaden east of Harar, Eritrean coast beyond Massawa, Chad, Central African, Palestinian edges) with no event

problems: Repair pass of 2026-10-25: third-saudi-state and khedivate-of-egypt re-validated (0 errors, --resolve); the other three dossiers of the batch (emirate-of-nejd, emirate-of-jabal-shammar, trucial-states) were not touched.

Gazetteer: the place 'Suakin' is unknown; the khedivate dossier uses it in seven specs (1885-1898 keyframe, 1881 contest start, 1885 interior loss and contest end, 1899 Suakin loss, two war zones), as do mahdist-state and anglo-egyptian-sudan. Until the gazetteer agent adds it (about 19.10 N 37.33 E) those specs do not resolve.

Cross-dossier mismatches for other groups: italian-africa starts in 1890 and has no 1885 gain of Massawa from khedivate-of-egypt (this dossier's counterpart is italian-africa); anglo-egyptian-sudan /ledger/1 founds the 22nd-parallel Sudan from mahdist-state although Wadi Halfa (19 January 1899) and Suakin (10 July 1899) come from khedivate-of-egypt, and its /ledger/3 (Halaib, 4 November 1902) has no mirror because the page calls it an administrative boundary; equatoria-province /ledger/0 names turco-egyptian-sudan, not khedivate-of-egypt, as parent of the 1885 Equatoria outpost; emirate-of-harar /ledger/3 names british-colonial-empire for the 1884 handover while khedivate-of-egypt /ledger/17 names emirate-of-harar as recipient; kuwait records no loss at Uqair (2 December 1922) and still names emirate-of-nejd.

Disagreement with the reviewer: the Zeila-Berbera loss of April 1884 has counterpart 'nobody', not british-colonial-empire (no page opened says Britain took Zeila at the withdrawal; the Zeila page has the Gadabuursi treaty of December 1884 and british-africa gains British Somaliland from nobody in 1888).

The Ikhwan raids on Transjordan page (infobox, 1922-1924) says Transjordan 'retrieves Al-Jawf, Wadi Sirhan and Kaf from Sultanate of Nejd', which Cliopatria's Nejd outline of 1924-1925 does not show; for the owners of kingdom-of-hejaz-and-nejd and the Transjordan dossier.

Beyond the review's list: the Idrisid Tihama coast is also taken out of third-saudi-state_1926 and out of its successor land, so that the realm handed to kingdom-of-hejaz-and-nejd does not hold the coast that asir /ledger/12 makes a vassal from 1926.

Page budget exceeded on purpose because the review named the pages: khedivate-of-egypt now lists 10 pages against a budget of 1-2 (Mahdist State, Massawa, Zeila, Suakin, Halaib Triangle, Anglo-Egyptian conquest of Sudan and Equatoria added); third-saudi-state lists 9 against the 5 of the first pass (Asir Province, Battle of Rawdat Muhanna, Ikhwan raids on Transjordan, Saudi Arabian-Kuwaiti neutral zone added).

Split of Cliopatria's 'Emirate of Nejd' stands: emirate-of-nejd is the Second Saudi State only (1824-1891) and third-saudi-state carries 1902-1926; dossiers of other groups (asir, kingdom-of-hejaz, kuwait) still name emirate-of-nejd for 1920-1925; the colour agent must seed third-saudi-state.

Counterpart slugs without a dossier: united-kingdom (eu-11 split), sultanate-of-egypt; the other counterparts used in the repair (equatoria-province, italian-africa, anglo-egyptian-sudan, mahdist-state, british-africa) have dossiers.
